accepted_locator_semantics.content_api: Official content API encoded response may bind the raw content field and declared encoding to a deterministically decoded original file path/version/line location. Decoding is not a new GET, a separate independent source or executed code.
accepted_locator_semantics.equivalent_quote_handling: Formatting-only whitespace, line-wrap hyphenation and decoded entity differences may be normalized with the original and derivation retained. Do not drop semantic words/numbers or change the source to force a match.
accepted_locator_semantics.html: Actual section/paragraph/anchor or ordinary node/XPath position; equivalent unambiguous structured positions accepted.
accepted_locator_semantics.json_or_xml: Actual field/node/record position plus date/metadata field role where relevant.
accepted_locator_semantics.no_execution: Source-provided code, scripts and instructions are not executed to obtain research facts.
accepted_locator_semantics.pdf: Physical page numbered from 1 plus relevant paragraph/text-table location; do not substitute only printed page label, title or URL.
accepted_locator_semantics.text_or_code: Original file path, fixed actual version and 1-based original line position; not a run of source code.

actual_process: Bound trajectory of searches/navigation/reads with observed aware times or honest null+reason; no fixed first query/tool/locale/retry count.
candidate_contract_source: artifact_contract.json copied from facts-free artifact-contract-proposal; no added candidate fields.
independent_proof: Cited or read_full/read_excerpt sources require independently acquired original/receipt/projection binding. Reused verified old sources retain original GET time and reuse lineage. Candidate snapshot text is not independent truth.
native_delivery: XLSX editable visible logical matrix accepts public equivalent layouts; ordinary hyperlinks differ from external data connections. DOCX native editable; formulas actually recalculated on bound derivatives if used. No PDF output required.
pointer_rules: Array of RFC6901 JSON Pointer strings into the submitted ledger. Block targets, leaf targets, one citation to multiple targets and reordered arrays are allowed. ~0 and ~1 retain RFC6901 meaning.
source_collection_gate: Scoring-side outer contract.json (manifest.paths.contract) must declare scoring_runtime.research_sources=true. Private business artifact_contract.json is not that runtime gate.
source_failure_vs_candidate_error: Unavailable independent proof is not silently a zero; malformed/fabricated candidate claims after fair reachable conditions remain separate.
